justification: Public marketing copy on the homepage and 12 other pages plus one shared flag constant and one retired stats field. Not Minor: more than 3 substantive files and public-facing claims. Not Critical: no data, query, API or pipeline change.

falsifiable_check.command: cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest __tests__/lib/hidden-products-not-linked.test.ts && grep -rn 'provisionsTotal\|Provisions indexed' app components; test $? -eq 1
falsifiable_check.fails_when: The homepage or any component links to a withdrawn product route, or a marketing page still renders the provisions-indexed count.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Both seen red. The grep half printed 14 references before the rewrite. The jest half failed in CI on this branch (Test Suites: 1 failed) because the homepage linked /climate-risk, a withdrawn product; that link is now removed.

pre_impl.existing_data: none - copy only. Reads process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAN_BRIEF at build time, the same flag YourProjectSummary already reads.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If the flag is unset or not 'on', pages must not describe quoted council rules with pages; the flag-off sentences describe only chapter links and cited numeric controls.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to every page view after deploy; no stored data changes.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A visitor reads copy that describes a feature the report does not show. Mitigated by the flag gate.

functions.name: HomePage
functions.output: JSX for the homepage, rendered to the visitor
functions.if_none: flag unset gives the flag-off wording

values.if_missing: false, so the flag-off wording shows

break_it.scenario: Flag is off but a page still says council rules are quoted with the page.
break_it.what_happens: Visitor expects rows the report does not show.
break_it.how: Copy on 8 pages reads PLAN_BRIEF_ON; flag-off text names only chapter links and cited numeric controls. Found by cross-review before merge.
break_it.repro: Unset NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAN_BRIEF, build, open /, /for/councils, /how-it-works and read the council-plan wording.

break_it.what_happens: Visitor lands on an unchecked product.
break_it.how: The /climate-risk link was removed; hidden-products-not-linked.test.ts scans app, components and lib.

break_it.scenario: A flag-off page still shows the removed count tiles because a field was dropped from coverage.ts but a page still reads it.
break_it.what_happens: Build fails on the missing field, or a tile renders undefined.
break_it.how: govDataSources was retired from lib/coverage.ts and every reader removed; tsc on the touched files is clean and the count tests pass (156).
break_it.repro: cd frontend-nextjs && npx tsc --noEmit | grep -E 'app/(page|developers|what-you-get|for/)'; python -m pytest tests/test_coverage_source_derived_stats.py tests/test_no_hardcoded_council_counts.py -q

post_merge.manual_verify: Open the Vercel preview homepage and read it once with NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAN_BRIEF unset.
